title: How Israel’s Settlement Surge in the West Bank Is Displacing Palestinians
summary: The Israeli government authorized 22 settlements in May, the largest expansion in decades, and Palestinian families are now being forced from their homes.

title: Verdure Targets More Sales of Securities Backed by Rooftop Solar
summary: Verdure Fund, which last month sold South Africa’s first securities backed by loans made to small-scale solar power facilities, plans further sales, starting with an issuance in the first quarter of next year.
